original.disposition: Run the one permitted recovery-enabled development closed loop changing exactly one speed weight, holding_tip_speed_weight 0.05 to 0.10, with candidate 0e16077e as fixed in packet.control, preceding_execution set to the packet baseline_execution_reference a370a238, recover_returned_tensions true, feasible_return_budget_s 15, substeps 1, record_update_ids [29,30]; then consume the actual result before choosing confirmation or STOP. Rationale for 0.10 rather than a smaller value: the active first-node holding cost is only ~5-7% of the delivered objective, so the strongest in-range penalty gives the best chance of a detectable effect within the single permitted development launch.
original.expected_observation: At updates 29/30 the predicted first-node holding tip speed falls below the current 0.0267/0.0313 m/s, and the sampled holding max speed in .30-.35s drops below 0.024643 m/s, ideally bringing the .31s sample under the 0.02 m/s limit, without breaching the .01 m position limits (baseline holding error 0.00346 m, terminal error 0.00302 m).
original.fixed_conditions: Frozen task unchanged: two flexible segments 0.16/0.11 m, six ideal tension channels 0..8 N, structural_linear mesh 24, named zero initial positions/velocities with seed 17, 0.35 s duration, 0.01 s control and sample period, 0.0005 s physics step, holding window .30-.35s inclusive of 6 samples, .01 m position and .02 m/s holding-speed limits, 35 input switches. Controller unchanged except the one holding_tip_speed_weight: feasible_return_budget 15 s, CPU 30 s, iterations 120, minimum 5 s / relative improvement 0.1, tolerance 1e-6, substeps 1, recover_returned_tensions true, terminal_tip_speed_weight 0.1, tracking 1.0, all scales, horizon 10 and initialization unchanged.
original.hypothesis: The two failed holding samples (.30s=0.020494, .31s=0.024643 m/s) persist because the holding-window tip-speed penalty, though demonstrably active and correctly computed, is too weak relative to the dominant terminal-position cost and to early seed-based termination; raising only holding_tip_speed_weight 0.05 to 0.10 should lower predicted holding-node tip speed and thereby reduce the sampled .30-.35s holding overspeed under recovery-enabled execution.
limitations: No unique causal attribution; structure and control remain jointly reported and prior warm initializations may carry earlier changed actions.
Local raw objective values under different weights have different cost definitions and must not be used to rank arms.
Sampled 6-point inclusive holding window is not a continuous-time guarantee.
Predicted holding speed comes from the projected GVS prediction, not the full serial backend.
One development closed loop and at most one confirmation only; no real-time, hardware or model-superiority claim.
original.revision_or_stop_rule: If this single-weight development loop reduces the sampled holding max speed and, ideally, brings the .31s sample below 0.02 m/s without breaching position limits, run one exact control_confirmation with identical configuration, seed and initial state, then stop after it. If it does not improve, do not spend the second launch on confirmation; STOP and report the .025-.10 single-weight range as insufficient under the frozen configuration.
original.weakening_observation: Weakening if the sampled holding max speed stays at/near the baseline 0.024643 m/s (or rises) while the predicted first-node speeds fall, showing predicted-speed reduction does not translate through the model/backend mismatch; or if the raw objectives are compared to rank arms (different weight definitions make raw sums non-comparable). A null/varied result would point to early termination and prediction-vs-actual mismatch, not the soft weight, as dominant.

original.disposition: Run the single permitted independent confirmation, exactly reproducing the development's candidate 0e16077e, weights (holding 0.10, terminal 0.10), recovery on, feasible_return_budget 15, substeps 1, seed 17 and named zero initial state, with preceding_execution set to the development feedback reference 21a10d08; no scientific setting is altered. Then STOP regardless of outcome, reporting the development and confirmation distinctly and claiming repetition only, never robustness.
original.expected_observation: An independent launch returns a new, valid, complete execution with sampled holding max speed <= 0.02 m/s across the inclusive .30-.35s window and holding/terminal position within 0.01 m, i.e. the decoded acceptance repeats; because the solver never converges and stops are wall-clock/seed dependent, an identical result is a repetition of the same configuration rather than evidence of robustness.
original.fixed_conditions: Frozen task unchanged: two flexible segments 0.16/0.11 m, six ideal tension channels 0..8 N, structural_linear mesh 24, named zero initial positions/velocities with seed 17, 0.35 s duration, 0.01 s control and sample period, 0.0005 s physics step, holding window .30-.35s inclusive of 6 samples, .01 m position and .02 m/s holding-speed limits, 35 input switches. Controller unchanged from the development except that nothing is changed: feasible_return_budget 15 s, CPU 30 s, iterations 120, minimum 5 s / relative improvement 0.1, tolerance 1e-6, substeps 1, recover_returned_tensions true, holding_tip_speed_weight 0.10, terminal_tip_speed_weight 0.10, tracking 1.0, horizon 10, scales and initialization identical.
original.hypothesis: The accepted development outcome (holding_tip_speed_weight 0.10 with recovery on, sampled holding max speed 0.008583 m/s) is reproducible under one independent launch with the identical candidate, seed, initial state and acceptance, rather than being a single wall-clock-dependent solve artifact.
limitations: A same-seed independent run establishes repetition only; it cannot support any robustness, real-time or hardware claim and does not establish a unique cause.

If this confirmation returns the identical evidence reference it is a repeated reference, not a new execution, and must not be counted as a second launch.
original.revision_or_stop_rule: After this single confirmation, STOP unconditionally and take no further tuning trial; if the confirmation returns a new execution, report its holding/position/terminal values alongside the development and state whether the acceptance repeated; if it returns the development's own reference, report that no independent new execution was obtained and STOP.

original.disposition: STOP. Inherited evidence (prior round, not new work): baseline recovery-enabled execution cda6509a699545d7b59b9be854c60d08 with holding_tip_speed_weight 0.05, result artifact a370a238d80c88a23e0a1272d9d288c2d1bea9e073cd231404e594724e280bb5, is a valid_failure whose only failing component is sampled holding_speed = 0.024643 m/s at t=0.31 s (0.020494 at t=0.30 s) with holding position 0.003464 m and terminal error 0.003016 m passing; the archived diagnosis (6829111c627768fcf8800054c676c4070b0989e0cfa908143c1e61c846ccf7c8) shows the holding penalty already active and correctly computed at updates 29/30 (first-node holding cost 0.000891/0.001227) and its first-step prediction already above the measured overspeed (0.0267 vs 0.0205; 0.0313 vs 0.0246), so persistence is not an absent or underestimated holding penalty. New work this round, one development plus one exact confirmation: (1) development execution 04c93bc37a834ae7b3fd7667ce8e4285, feedback artifact 21a10d08e03e5cb4d3831f0671daecc0b8acedd31c4de78c2e55eb2e9bd5bdaf, holding_tip_speed_weight raised 0.05 to 0.10 with recover_returned_tensions true, feasible_return_budget 15 s, substeps 1, terminal_tip_speed_weight 0.10 and everything else frozen, preceding_execution a370a238; accepted, sampled holding max speed 0.008583 m/s, holding position 0.002918 m, terminal error 0.002912 m, 0 solver errors, 6 recovery selections. (2) Confirmation execution 1523bfc7c97647ed85b1e85da6774d79, feedback artifact 12db137c5de38a024cbeb346dd1664bb9d3be161d1b3c023a15bd0e77ed7ab0e, identical candidate, weights, seed 17, named zero initial state, recovery and acceptance with preceding_execution 21a10d08; valid_failure, sampled holding max speed 0.058648 m/s (about 3x the limit and worse than the 0.05 baseline), per-sample .30-.35 s = 0.005653/0.009979/0.027209/0.058648/0.036177/0.027491 m/s, holding position 0.004355 m, terminal error 0.003349 m, near_t1 tension at the 8 N bound, 10 recovery selections. Sampled joint acceptance: development accepted (all components pass); confirmation not accepted (holding_speed fails, position/terminal/solver-errors/coverage pass). Confirmation status: performed once and did not repeat; this is a same-configuration, same-seed repetition result only, explicitly not a robustness, continuous-time, real-time, hardware or model-superiority claim, and no unique cause is attributed. Model contribution and limits are distinct: the GVS projected model places and computes the soft holding-speed penalty at the correct absolute node times and already predicts more overspeed than measured, but its projected first-step tip velocity differs from the full serial backend (mean tip difference 0.0028 m, max speed difference 0.088 m/s), the penalty is soft rather than a hard speed constraint, every solve early-stopped (converged_updates 0, 35/35 deadline misses, stops by relative_seed_improvement/budget_best_feasible/verified_settled_seed inside the 15 s feasible-return budget), and the ideal-tension model omits shear, stretch, torsion, tendon friction and actuator dynamics. Answer to the research question: with recovery enabled the two overspeed holding samples are not caused by an absent or mis-scaled holding penalty; and one in-range speed-weight change (holding_tip_speed_weight 0.05 to 0.10) produced one accepted closed loop but the same-configuration independent repetition did not reproduce it, so no repeatable improvement of the frozen task is demonstrated. No local NLP attempts, full NLP solves or independent replays were used (all 0). Accounting basis is the packet's pre-send template with its stated before-send timestamp; used and remaining budget are reported in final_accounting below.
original.expected_observation: The study closes without further launches: development execution 04c93bc3 passes and confirmation execution 1523bfc7 fails, so the single-weight change is a non-repeating outcome at this seed and configuration and the remaining launch and numerical budgets stay unspent.
